skill.summary: AI flat-lay clothing generator — create professional flat-lay product images from a photo

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the flat-lay-openapi-skill.
- Generate professional flat-lay product images from garment or model photos.
- Requires HTTPS and a WESHOP_API_KEY for authentication.
- Provides endpoints for starting runs, polling status, and uploading images.
- Customizable options for model, resolution, aspect ratio, and batch size.
- Highlights strong API key security and usage practices.
